title: Stable and Counterfactually Robust Physical World Models from Imposed Structure and Learned Physics
abstract: arXiv:2610.00280v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A world model learns to forecast how a physical system evolves from recorded trajectories, yet the systems it imitates obey physical laws that are neither fully supplied nor reliably respected. The model may create energy, drift or diverge over long rollouts, and answer a changed law query using the law observed during training. We ask how much general physical structure must be hard coded into a world model, and how much system-specific physics can then be learned from data, for four properties to hold simultaneously: second law compatible dissipation, correct responses to interventions on physical parameters, stability out to one hundred times the training horizon, and robustness to disturbances. The imposed structure is general: dynamics are generated from the gradient of a learned energy through a fixed reversible operator, the energy is restricted to a confining class, a one way port can remove energy but never inject it, the drive

translated_title: 基于施加结构与学习物理的稳定且反事实鲁棒的物理世界模型
translated_abstract: 世界模型学习根据记录的轨迹来预测物理系统如何演化，然而它所模仿的系统所遵循的物理定律既未被完整提供，也未能被可靠地遵守。模型可能会凭空产生能量，在长时程滚动预测中漂移或发散，并且在被问及“定律已改变”的问题时，仍使用训练期间观察到的定律来作答。我们探究：为了使以下四个性质同时成立——与热力学第二定律相容的耗散、对物理参数干预的正确响应、在训练时程一百倍范围外的稳定性、以及对扰动的鲁棒性——需要将多少一般性物理结构硬编码进世界模型，之后又有多少系统特定的物理可以从数据中学习。所施加的结构是通用的：动力学由学习到的能量函数的梯度通过固定的可逆算子生成；能量被限制在一个受限类中；一个单向端口可以移除能量但绝不会注入能量；驱动
tldr: 该论文提出将通用的物理结构（可逆算子、受限能量函数、单向耗散端口等）硬编码进世界模型，并从数据中学习系统特定的物理，从而构建同时满足热力学第二定律相容耗散、正确响应物理参数干预、训练时程百倍范围的稳定性以及扰动鲁棒性的物理世界模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes hard-coding general physical structure (fixed reversible operators, confining energy functions, one-way dissipation ports) into world models while learning system-specific physics from data, yielding physical world models that simultaneously achieve second-law-compatible dissipation, correct counterfactual responses to interventions on physical parameters, stability far beyond the training horizon, and robustness to disturbances.
